about_the_game:
Welcome to 'TO Be Continued'!

'TO Be Continued'is a text-based interrogation game where players take on the role of an intern at the Downtown Valuation Bureau. By reviewing the information of the accused and communicating with them, players can determine whether they should stay or be expelled through dialogue. Your decision will determine the fate of the accused, so please listen to your heart and morality and make the decision you think is right!

Game features:

Manga style, with black and white as the main color tone, supplemented by embellishments and metaphorical coloring, creating a special expressive power.

Fragmented narrative is used to create a society that prioritizes values and is very indifferent to older workers, in order to satirize the reality of age discrimination.

Interrogators with diverse personalities and experiences showcase the various facets of the world, triggering resonance and reflection on reality.

Players can choose to become interrogators who fight against alienation or advocate for a cold-blooded system, which is a moral dilemma.
